Heavy Equipment Operator Licenses (SIO) in Indonesia: Forklift, Crane & Earthmoving Plant

Statutory requirements for operating heavy mobile plant, material handling, and lifting machinery under Indonesian labor law: license classes, capacity thresholds, and 5-year renewal rules.

Permenaker 08/2020 Lifting & transport statutory law
Official Kemnaker SIO Government photographic license
5-Year Validity Statutory renewal maintenance
Statutory Mandate

What is an SIO and Why is it Legally Required?

In Indonesia, operating heavy industrial machinery without a valid Surat Izin Operator (SIO) issued directly by the Ministry of Manpower is a severe statutory violation under Permenaker No. 08 of 2020. A standard public driver's license (SIM) or an overseas operator card holds zero legal validity on Indonesian worksites.

Immediate Site Shutdown Risk

During routine Disnaker labor inspections or client HSE audits on EPC sites, an uncertified equipment operator triggers an immediate equipment impoundment notice (Nota Pembekuan). In the event of an incident involving an unlicensed operator, insurance claims are denied and project management faces direct criminal prosecution under Law No. 1/1970.

Equipment Classifications

Common SIO License Categories & Classes

Machinery Type Class / Category Capacity Threshold Credential Issued
Forklift / Reach Truck Class II (Kelas II) Capacity up to 15 Tons SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Class I (Kelas I) Capacity exceeding 15 Tons SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Mobile / Crawler Crane Class III (Kelas III) Capacity up to 25 Tons SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Class II (Kelas II) Capacity 25 to 100 Tons SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Class I (Kelas I) Capacity exceeding 100 Tons SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Overhead / Gantry Crane Class I & II Tonnage dependent SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Excavator / Bulldozer / Loader Operator Alat Berat Earthmoving machinery SIO Kemnaker (5 Years)
Rigging & Signalman Rigger (Juru Ikat Beban) Lifting operation hookup SIO / Lisensi Kemnaker
Statutory Machinery Companion

Remember: SIO (Operator) Requires SIA (Equipment)

Holding a certified operator is only half of the legal requirement. The machinery itself must possess a valid, active Surat Izin Alat (SIA / Riksa Uji Certificate) issued within the last 12 months. An authorized operator driving an uncertified machine remains an active compliance violation.
